settings.title:
Discover the Innovive
Research-Ready IVC System

settings.editor: The Innovive Disposable IVC System enhances animal welfare and operational efficiency with advanced technology that improves ergonomics, biosecurity, sustainability, and scalability—letting you focus on valuable research.
The Innorack’s high-precision airflow ensures optimal ventilation in every cage, efficiently removing ammonia and CO2 gases.
Grow your in vivo research effortlessly; our adaptable staff scales with your needs.
The Innovive System provides the best cage-level environment for your animals.
Studies have shown lower ammonia levels than washable systems
BPA can have harmful effects on laboratory animals. Innovive cages are made from recyclable, 100% BPA-free PET plastic.
No repetitive strain from washing cages or processing activities commonly associated with repetitive strain injuries.
Innovive cages reduces physical strain on staff. A third-party analysis shows Innovive reduces ergonomic risks.
Easy-to-manage, lightweight pre-filled bottles for  reliable hydration. Choose from acidified, chlorinated or purified water.
Dual HEPA filters ensure superior biocontainment.
Double-bagged, irradiated cages minimize contamination risk.
Transparent bioload testing and irradiation certificates.
